title: Zesty Moroccan Chicken Leg Tagine
description: A flavorful and crispy Moroccan dish featuring chicken legs, tadka, and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a post-workout meal, cooked in a claypot.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the claypot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the claypot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the claypot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken legs to the claypot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the claypot and stir to combine.
Pour the lemon juice and chicken broth into the claypot and bring to a boil.
Cover the claypot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
